title: Entopest Monitoring Moth Traps | 10 Refill Pads & 5 Reusable Hangers | Clothes Moth Detection | Sticky Monitoring Pads for Wardrobes | Pheromone-Based Monitoring Only
bullet_points: 🧰 Complete Monitoring Kit for Clothes Moths – This kit includes 10 pheromone pads and 5 clear hangers, designed to help detect the presence of Common Clothes Moths (Tineola bisselliella) in wardrobes and carpets. Intended solely for monitoring purposes, this non-biocidal solution supports early identification of moth activity in indoor environments.

🧪 Long-Lasting Pheromone Monitoring – Entopest pads release a species-specific synthetic pheromone designed to attract male clothes moths (Tineola bisselliella) for monitoring purposes only. Each pad is effective for up to 12 weeks, helping support early detection of moth presence in affected areas.

🧬 Species-Specific Formula – The pheromone is tailored exclusively for monitoring male Common Clothes Moths (Tineola bisselliella). While it may occasionally attract related species such as the Case-bearing or Pale-backed Clothes Moth, effectiveness with other species is not guaranteed. A free species identification service is available if needed.

🧩 Includes 5 Reusable Pad Holders – The kit comes with clear, UK-manufactured holders designed for versatile placement in wardrobes, drawers, and hard-to-reach areas like under furniture. These holders keep adhesive pads elevated and away from textiles while allowing free pheromone dispersion and moth access. Durable and reusable for long-term monitoring.

🗺️ Easy Placement with Guidance – Pads should be positioned in areas where moth activity is likely, such as wardrobes, near carpets, and behind furniture. Comprehensive instructions, optional guidance videos, and technical support are included to assist with correct placement and effective monitoring.
